About Kulexar

Chartered professionals delivering responsive, cost-effective, and bespoke compliance solutions.

Who We Are

Specialists in Compliance & ESG Strategy

At Kulexar Consulting Ltd, we help organisations achieve and maintain the highest standards of compliance, safety, and operational excellence. Our expertise spans QSHE (Quality, Safety, Health & Environment), passive fire protection, fire risk assessment, compliance management, and sustainability, supporting businesses across a variety of sectors.

We work closely with clients to provide practical, independent assurance services that identify risks, strengthen compliance frameworks, and drive continuous improvement. From mock audits and subcontractor audit services to spot-check compliance visits, we deliver objective assessments and actionable recommendations that help organisations meet regulatory requirements and industry best practice.

Our approach is built on professionalism, integrity, and collaboration. We understand that every organisation faces unique challenges, which is why we tailor our services to provide clear, effective solutions that protect people, assets, and reputation while supporting long-term sustainable growth.

Our Core Capabilities

What We Do

Passive Fire Protection

We provide expert surveys and advice relating to all elements of passive fire protection in construction, including fire doors, fire compartmentation, and passive fire stopping.

Sustainability & Net Zero

Our expertise can help you embed sustainability within your operations and progress your net zero journey by decarbonising your business. Our services include policy development, energy usage reviews, and best practice workshops.

Safety, Health, Environment & Quality (SHEQ)

Our services support you in meeting all of your SHEQ requirements, including management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001), risk assessments, training, and site audits.

Procurement

Our expertise includes policy and strategy development for responsible sourcing, supply base rationalisation, bid writing, and award submission services.
